methods.description: Divide annual decimal rate by365 and count the specified inclusive charged dates.
Apply daily compound growth for the specified purchase or cash advance conditions.
Subtract original purchases from the compounded total without intermediate rounding.
Calculate each purchase for its own days and add unrounded amounts.
Apply the given percentage and any fixed minimum to the closing balance.
Apply all conditions stated for the model card before deciding whether interest is charged.
Explain current-balance interest and variable repayments, using supplied conditions.
Subtract the payment at its stated time before or after a growth interval.
Test each supplied annual rate through the same daily future-value calculation.
